$comment: The four 3Lines Group companies. AUTHORED, not generated — unlike non-cms.json, no script writes this file, so it is safe to hand-edit and survives `npm run ingest`. Names and taglines are transcribed verbatim, both locales, from the bento on the live site (3lines.com.sa/{en,ar}), which is the only place this content exists: it has no CMS record and no entry in content-inventory.json.
$comment_learnMore: One CTA label for every card, as on the source. Carried as data so it reaches `link.label` like every other block's CTA, rather than becoming an authored UI string in lib/ui.ts.
$comment_span: Bento emphasis, mirroring the proportions the source grid gives each card: Defense Technology is the wide one, XR the tall one, the other two standard.

items.$comment_name: Renamed from the source's 'Defense Technology'. The tagline follows the name so the card does not introduce itself as one thing and describe another; the Arabic reuses the site's own wording for 'advanced technologies' (see non-cms.json heroRotatingWords).

tagline.en: Providing advanced technologies solutions and services

items.$comment_href: The source card's 'Learn more' is JS-driven and carries no href in the DOM. Pointed at this site's own services index, which is what the card describes.

tagline.ar: الواقع الممتد عن طريق الواقع المعزز و الواقع الافتراضي
حلول البنية التحتية للبصريات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات

items.$comment_logo: The only one of the four with a brand mark in this repo; it is already carried as a partner logo.

items.$comment: Replaces the source's pre-launch ATV card. This division is live, so it carries a link and no 'Soon!' status. English tagline is the site's own og:description; ai3lines.com has no Arabic route (/ar 404s), so the Arabic here is AUTHORED rather than transcribed.
items.$comment_name: Displayed as a company name alongside its siblings rather than as the ai3lines.com domain. Latin in both locales, as XR and Optokon Middle East are.

tagline.en: AI agents that run your business operations
tagline.ar: وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي يديرون عمليات أعمالك
